out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the bar being used to store a bottle of bleach.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. Person in charge removed bleach from sink.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at either handwashing sink in kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. Person in charge provided paper towels.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: mushrooms from can (52F), sliced ham (49F), tomato sauce (52F), cooked sausage (52F) in 3 door prep unit.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Person in charge placed all items in walk in cooler to be cooled.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 3 door prep unit (50F)
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. Person in charge removed all items from cooler and contacted repair technician.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers stored on pizza oven and cook line in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. Person in charge discarded personal drinks.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: marinara sauce (108F) in steam well.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. Person in charge reheated marinara to 165F.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions. Observed no QUAT test strips.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a QUATERNARY AMMONIA test kit. PIC ordered test kit.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: warewashing racks observed with melted portions accumulating black/brown build-up.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. Warewashing racks that are not maintained in good condition or cannot be cleaned effectively shall be replaced.

violations.title: Equipment Cooking Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment were observed soiled with an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and/or other debris: Pizza oven conveyor belt. PIC stated it is cleaned every 6 months .
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue and other debris to maintain a sanitary work environment and prevent pest attraction. All kitchen equipment must be cleaned frequently to eliminate harborage conditions for pests.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Dressing Rooms/Lockers, Designated
violations.observation: Employees are not using the dressing rooms or lockers provided. EHS observed a hooded sweatshirt hanging from the cheese shredding machine.
violations.corrective_action: Instruct employees to use the designated dressing rooms to prevent contamination of food, food equipment and utensils, and preparation surfaces. EHS instructed employee to place their belongings in the staff storage closet with hanging hooks for clothing.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: meatball (50F), sliced mozzarella (51F), mushroom (50F) in unit (3); Pizza sauce (45F), mushroom (44F), sliced tomato (46F), lasagna (45F), shredded cheese (45F), grilled chicken (44-45F), cooked spaghetti (44F) in unit (5)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC cooled all items from unit (3) in ice baths. PIC discarded all items from unit (5).

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC removed all tcs items and will discontinue use of unit until repair is complete.
